name: White Card Practice Test
fullName: White Card course, CPCWHS1001 Prepare to work safely in the construction industry

categoryNotes.auwhiteLaw: Element 1 (duty holders, duty of care, rights) and 3.2 (designated safety personnel); model WHS Act; card rules
categoryNotes.auwhiteRisk: Element 2.1 and 2.4: hazard, risk, the unit's five steps, hierarchy of controls, JSA, SWMS, high risk construction work
categoryNotes.auwhiteHeights: Knowledge evidence: working at heights incl. scaffolding, falling objects, unplanned collapse, excavations and trenches incl. underground services
categoryNotes.auwhitePlant: Knowledge evidence: electrical (power lines, cords, equipment), plant and equipment, traffic and mobile plant, high-risk work licences, lockout tags
categoryNotes.auwhiteHealth: Knowledge evidence: asbestos, dust, hazardous substances and dangerous goods, confined spaces; SDS
categoryNotes.auwhiteEnv: Knowledge evidence: manual handling, noise, UV, hot and cold environments; drugs, alcohol and fatigue
categoryNotes.auwhiteSigns: Element 3.3 and 2.3: sign and tag categories (AS 1319), PPE selection and fit
categoryNotes.auwhiteEmerg: Element 3.4 and 4: incidents, notifiable incidents, emergencies, fire equipment, first aid, reporting
